parallels.note: It came to pass, when the priests had come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled Yahweh’s house,
so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for Yahweh’s glory filled Yahweh’s house.

translations.web: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for Yahweh’s glory filled God’s house.
translations.bsb: so that the priests could not stand there to minister because of the cloud. For the glory of the LORD filled the house of God.
translations.kjv: So that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of God.
translations.asv: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud: for the glory of Jehovah filled the house of God.
